The '''StarForge Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="SAV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> along the [[Ado Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[StarForge Station]] was hidden in the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. Although its name was similar to that of the [[Star Forge]], an ancient automated shipyard built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], no relation existed; the nebula took its name from the large number of stars undergoing stellar formation within it.<ref name="SAV" />
